project.author: WarpForge Examples
project.description: In-studio sprite runtime demo. Open this file, then click the ⚑ green flag in the Stage panel. Two sprites: Friend bounces around (space = grow, click = ouch); Counter tracks a score variable (a = +1, b = -1, c = reset).

sprites.name: Friend
sprites.scripts_xml: <xml xmlns="https://developers.google.com/blockly/xml"><block type="scratch_event_when_flag_clicked" id="f_hat_flag" x="40" y="40"><next><block type="scratch_looks_show" id="f_show"><next><block type="scratch_looks_set_size" id="f_setsize"><field name="SIZE">80</field><next><block type="scratch_motion_goto_xy" id="f_goto"><field name="X">0</field><field name="Y">0</field><next><block type="scratch_motion_point_in_direction" id="f_dir"><field name="DIRECTION">60</field><next><block type="scratch_looks_say_for_secs" id="f_hi"><field name="MESSAGE">Hi! Click me to grow.</field><field name="SECS">2</field><next><block type="scratch_control_forever" id="f_for"><statement name="DO"><block type="scratch_motion_move_steps" id="f_move"><field name="STEPS">5</field><next><block type="scratch_motion_if_on_edge_bounce" id="f_bounce"/></next></block></statement></block></next></block></next></block></next></block></next></block></next></block></next></block><block type="scratch_event_when_key_pressed" id="f_hat_space" x="40" y="360"><field name="KEY">space</field><next><block type="scratch_looks_change_size" id="f_grow"><field name="DSIZE">10</field></block></next></block><block type="scratch_event_when_this_sprite_clicked" id="f_hat_click" x="40" y="460"><next><block type="scratch_looks_say_for_secs" id="f_ouch"><field name="MESSAGE">Ouch!</field><field name="SECS">0.5</field></block></next></block></xml>

sprites.name: Counter
sprites.scripts_xml: <xml xmlns="https://developers.google.com/blockly/xml"><block type="scratch_event_when_flag_clicked" id="c_hat_flag" x="40" y="40"><next><block type="scratch_looks_hide" id="c_hide"><next><block type="scratch_data_set_variable" id="c_init"><field name="VARIABLE">score</field><field name="VALUE">0</field><next><block type="scratch_data_show_variable" id="c_show"><field name="VARIABLE">score</field></block></next></block></next></block></next></block><block type="scratch_event_when_key_pressed" id="c_hat_a" x="40" y="260"><field name="KEY">a</field><next><block type="scratch_data_change_variable" id="c_inc"><field name="VARIABLE">score</field><field name="VALUE">1</field></block></next></block><block type="scratch_event_when_key_pressed" id="c_hat_b" x="40" y="360"><field name="KEY">b</field><next><block type="scratch_data_change_variable" id="c_dec"><field name="VARIABLE">score</field><field name="VALUE">-1</field></block></next></block><block type="scratch_event_when_key_pressed" id="c_hat_c" x="40" y="460"><field name="KEY">c</field><next><block type="scratch_data_set_variable" id="c_clear"><field name="VARIABLE">score</field><field name="VALUE">0</field></block></next></block></xml>
